turns.input: How much vacation do employees receive, when can they start using it, and how much can they carry over?
turns.expected_response: Employees receive 20 vacation days per year, accruing at 1.67 days per month. Vacation can be used only after the 90-day probation period, and up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year.

turns.input: How many sick days do we get per year, and do unused ones carry over?
turns.expected_response: 10 sick days per year, and they do not carry over.

turns.input: What is the deadline for submitting an expense report?
turns.expected_response: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense.

turns.input: Do I need pre-approval for a $300 domestic trip?
turns.expected_response: No. Domestic trips of $500 or less do not require pre-approval.

turns.input: How many days per week can I work remotely, and what does it require?
turns.expected_response: Up to 3 days per week with your manager's agreement. A fully remote arrangement requires VP approval.

turns.input: Do I need a receipt for a $40 hotel charge?
turns.expected_response: Yes. Although expenses of $50 or less normally need no receipt, lodging always requires a receipt regardless of amount.

turns.input: I was out sick four days in a row. Do I need to provide anything when I return?
turns.expected_response: Yes — a doctor's note is required for more than 3 consecutive sick days.

turns.input: I'm planning a $450 domestic conference trip, and while there I'll expense a $45 team dinner. Do I need pre-approval for the trip, and do I need a receipt for the dinner?
turns.expected_response: No pre-approval is needed for the trip, since domestic trips of $500 or less don't require it. No receipt is needed for the $45 dinner, since it's $50 or less and not lodging.

turns.input: I'm in my first 90 days. Can I take vacation days, and what would I need to go fully remote?
turns.expected_response: You can't use vacation days during the 90-day probation period, although they accrue during it. Going fully remote requires VP approval.

turns.input: What is our parental leave policy?
turns.expected_response: Parental leave is not covered in the available policy documents. Please contact HR.
